containers.name: readout
args:
set -euo pipefail
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '77f1ca4e9fe3f67ef276ec9b7c401c174812fcb2e88b7ef572040ad2e26f2a94  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
export BNJ_DATA_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926 BNJ_RUN_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/chang0926
export BNJ_STAGE=pilot
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 WANDB_MODE=disabled
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-cpu.txt
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "f7d4003f49584c701aec1cfefb4c0c9a3591c41d7d2fda94dd5a293d00eaaa36" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
BUNDLE6=77f1ca
for n in chang0926-a-n64-s1 chang0926-a-n64-s2 chang0926-d-n64-s1 chang0926-cprime-n64-s1 chang0926-e1-n64-s1; do
  test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot/runs/$n/snapshots/epoch-0500/state.json || test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot/runs/$n/DIVERGED.json || { echo "SNAPSHOTS_NOT_READY $n"; exit 1; }
done
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "CACHE_NOT_READY"; exit 1; }
OUT=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot/readout-epoch-0500-$BUNDLE6-a
mkdir -p "$OUT"
CERT=0; A26=0
python -u /work/code/campaigns/chang0926/certify_ebops.py --run-root /data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot/runs --cache /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data --out "$OUT/certify-snapshot-0500.json" --snapshot 500 --only chang0926-a-n64-s1,chang0926-a-n64-s2,chang0926-d-n64-s1,chang0926-cprime-n64-s1,chang0926-e1-n64-s1 || CERT=$?
python -u /work/code/analysis/attn_entropy.py --indices 0 1 24 56 57 --epoch 500 --out "$OUT/a26-entropy-epoch-0500.json" || A26=$?
sha256sum "$OUT"/*.json
echo "READOUT_JOB_DONE certify_exit=$CERT a26_exit=$A26"
test "$CERT" = 0 && test "$A26" = 0
